item.content:encoded:
So here's what I've got from it, and what I don't get but get what it is that I don't get. Please tell me if I have misunderstood anything, as most of my statements are really just requests for confirmation ;P

+spoilers for this and future entries in the series
-spoilers

Anomalies are instances of the Being from before time and order managing to buck out of the Pattern's restraints, if just a tiny bit

The imagery of a black and white spiral reminds me of the Spiral Gestalt, as well as the black spiral images in SCP-2747/LUCID CHALICE. Is there any connection between these three? Not really of note but interesting to me is that, in this context, "Spiral Gestalt" is an oxymoron, one of the spiral's/Pattern's main constraints being that any system cannot be greater than the sum of its parts.

Also, does/how does this fit in with the Builder, SCP-184? (Possible spoilers for that here) I read somewhere that all the alternate Milky Ways in Code Name: The Truth were created by 184, the whole universe, or at least our galaxy, being the "enclosed structure" it's housed in and erroneously expanding, and that anomalies were extra-weird cases of its duplication errors.

Also, why did Cain release Apakht?
